readestImport.match.subtitle: {source}. Previewing does not change your library.

readestImport.match.noLocal: No EPUB on this shelf can be matched. Import those books here first.

readestImport.review.subtitle: Every position was checked against the local book.

readestImport.progress.replace: Replace the local position with Readest's

readestImport.reason.spine-guessed: Approximate: chapter inferred from its order
readestImport.reason.id-corrected: Approximate: position corrected by element ID
readestImport.reason.text-relocated: Approximate: the position moved; found again by its text in this chapter
readestImport.reason.text-differs: Approximate: the text here differs from Readest's record
readestImport.reason.bad-cfi: Not found: the position record cannot be read
readestImport.reason.chapter-missing: Not found: the local book has no such chapter

readestImport.reason.text-ambiguous: Not found: this text appears more than once in the chapter
readestImport.reason.too-long: Not found: the content exceeds the length limit
readestImport.reason.highlight-only: A highlight without note text is not imported in this version
readestImport.review.footer: Items imported before are skipped. Cancelling or a failure writes nothing.
readestImport.plan.too-many-books: Up to 128 books can be imported at once; select fewer
readestImport.plan.too-many-records: Up to 20000 items can be imported at once (now {count}); select fewer
readestImport.done: Imported from Readest: {added} bookmarks and notes, reading positions for {progress} books
readestImport.done.unchanged: Positions unchanged since the last import: {count}
readestImport.error.invalid: The Readest backup cannot be read or is damaged. Nothing was written
readestImport.error.tooLarge: The Readest backup is too large. Nothing was written
readestImport.error.changed: A local book or the backup changed after the preview. Nothing was written; please import again
readestImport.error.readerBusy: A book is open for reading. Close its reader tabs, then import again
readestImport.error.closed: The import ended (shelf switched, locked or cancelled). Nothing was written
readestImport.error.busy: Another import or shelf task is running. Try again later
readestImport.error.randomAccess: The backup cannot be read from this location. Save it to this device first, then import from there
